briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Elite: Answer the Ophanim Wheel Court: Key Verdict. Enter Ophanim Wheel Court on Choir-Vault Discord Ascent through The Choir-Vault Gate while the Gate remains Wound Gate leaking memory-burning radiance. Reference deity voice is Michael, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, defeat the elite lock against Ophanim Shear-Wheel inside the elite-tuned Ophanim Wheel Court and prove the active deity can endure the trial alone.

missionIntro.speaker: Michael Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: The choir does not forgive discord; it measures it. The Ophanim Wheel Court will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the elite pressure of Choir-Vault Discord Ascent made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: edict seals that forbid actions until answered

victory.speaker: Michael Divine Voice
victory.text: The discord thins; the ascent keeps its shape.

defeat.speaker: Michael Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The The Choir-Vault Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: The Radiant Hierarchies is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Ophanim Wheel Court as part of Choir-Vault Discord Ascent.

soloTitanPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Ophanim Wheel Court as a elite node in Choir-Vault Discord Ascent; white-gold radiance, many-eye auras, glass armor, feathered and non-feathered wing geometries, bell-metal joints, choral vibration lines, living scroll seals, stair-ladders of light, cathedral vault anatomy, ophanim wheels, seraph fire, cherub guardian masks.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable Titan language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Titan language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
